mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_revision (report_id, actor_account_id, from_version, to_version, change_payload, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{actorAccountId}, #{fromVersion}, #{toVersion}, #{changePayload}, #{reason}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, actor_account_id, from_version, to_version, change_payload, reason, created_at FROM report_revision WHERE report_id = #{reportId} ORDER BY to_version DESC, id DESC
